title: The Compiler Whisperer — census of every silently-dropped diagnostic in tsc5 and tsgo

compilers.tsgo-unfused: same commit, all fuse constants disabled (Act XIV build)

method: Exhaustive grep of every TernaryMaybe return, bail-out, discarded check result, suppressed-diagnostic flag and errorType substitution in both checkers; each candidate site probed with a targeted reproducer run on all three compilers. Raw run data: data/phaseXX_whisperer_raw.json (runner: linux/run_whisperer_census.py).

class-A-tsgo-unique-silent-accept.status: PROVEN HOLE (Acts XIV-XVI corpus: 28 cases, 11 construct families)
class-A-tsgo-unique-silent-accept.tsc5-counterpart: returns {overflow, False} + emits TS2321 'Excessive stack depth comparing types' — loud bail
class-A-tsgo-unique-silent-accept.verdict: tsgo reads the unmarked Maybe as success: wrong-code silent accept AND no depth warning. Boundary exact at type depth 101.

class-B-post-fuse-permissive-any.site: tsgo internal/checker/checker.go:22225 / tsc5 instantiateType (identical constants: depth==100 || count>=5_000_000)
class-B-post-fuse-permissive-any.mechanism: fuse trips once — one loud TS2589 — and yields errorType, which is universally assignable; every subsequent check involving that type silently passes
class-B-post-fuse-permissive-any.evidence: post-fuse-1: `const wrong: {x:number} = bomb` silently accepted on BOTH compilers (only the fuse error + an unrelated shallow error print). post-fuse-2: two independent bombs each trip once; both wrong-shape assignments swallowed.
class-B-post-fuse-permissive-any.verdict: a real silent-accept in BOTH checkers — diagnosed once at the fuse, then permissive-forever per type. tsc5's own silent spot.

class-E-config-gate-asymmetry.tsgo-side: file args + tsconfig.json in cwd: emits ONLY TS5112, skips compilation entirely — every diagnostic in the file dropped (loud failure, silent checking)
class-E-config-gate-asymmetry.tsc5-side: same invocation: silently ignores the project config, compiles with command-line defaults — `strict:true` project + `tsc anytest.ts` => rc=0, the TS7006 implicit-any error never reported (false clean)
class-E-config-gate-asymmetry.verdict: both checkers go quiet at the same edge, in opposite directions: tsgo hides every diagnostic behind a config complaint; tsc5 hides that your project's rules were never applied

sites.expanding-Both: relater.go:3162 / tsc5 _tsc.js:65708 — expandingFlags==Both -> TernaryMaybe (both emit tracer event recursiveTypeRelatedTo_DepthLimit). PROBES: phantom-deep (Deep<T>={v:Deep<T[]>}), phantom-recur (interface B<T>{v:B<T>}) — accepted correctly on all three; a finite error cannot be hidden below the trigger depth because any real difference materializes at level 1 (generic-leaf probe: D6<T> vs D6<number> -> TS2322 on all three).
sites.conditional-10: relater.go:3576,3757 / tsc5 _tsc.js:66137,66255 — 10 same-identity conditional levels -> Maybe. Same reach-but-harmless geometry.
sites.union-include: relater.go:1225,1232 — target union already contains source -> Maybe. Parity.
sites.inference-circularity: inference.go:352,355 (depth 2) + 1074,1077 (reverse-mapped) / tsc5 _tsc.js:68741,68344 — expanding-Both skips the inference action, sets Circularity priority. Benign: params infer at top level before descent (inference-top-arg probe: T=string, correct on all three).

class-C-benign-bails-parity.verdict: fires, but provably cannot swallow a finite error — Maybe only materializes where the compared shapes are infinitely self-similar

sites: CheckModeTypeOnly (checker.go:48,12567-12570) — getTypeOfExpression deliberately omits diagnostics for internal queries
reportErrors=false global resolvers (checker.go:1068-1086 — ~20 sites: ESSymbol, BigInt, Promise, ImportMeta...) — missing-lib types degrade to silent unknown/errorType
isTypeComparableTo / flow-pruning relation queries with reportErrors=false
tracer-only bail events (instantiateType_DepthLimit, recursiveTypeRelatedTo_DepthLimit) — the compiler logs its own bail into a channel no user sees
diagnostic dedup (program.go:1610-1633) — identical diagnostics merged into one with related-info
class-D-by-design-quiet-channels.verdict: intended suppression — diagnostics are omitted by design when the check is a query, not a report

proven_silent_swallows: config-gate whole-file suppression (tsgo) + silent config bypass (tsc5)

novelty_labels.new: post-fuse permissive-any suppression as a shared silent-accept class; the config-gate asymmetry (tsgo drops all diagnostics / tsc5 drops all project options); the complete Maybe+bail site census with per-site verdicts
novelty_labels.confirmed_known: tsc5 silently ignores tsconfig when given file args (long-standing behavior, now quantified as a diagnostic-drop class)
